proposals.evidence: DEDR4677 gives Kannada maṇḍi and Kuwi meṇḍa knee. Survey maṇḍi and mendaya preserve their morphology; Kodagu maṇḍi is a comparative extension explicitly only a look-alike in the source, not a literal dictionary attestation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey Irula mukilɨ and Kannada muyɨlɨ/muyulu are comparative final-vowel and medial-consonant variants; their complete transcriptions remain unchanged. Parji malgur is an exact dictionary match.
